jobs.description:
Experienced Environmental Fate / Modelling Expert (m/f/d)

For more than 25 years RIFCON GmbH is an independent scientific consulting company offering comprehensive professional services for the registration of synthetic and biological plant protection products. Our head office is located in Hirschberg near Heidelberg in Germany. About 200 employees offer services ranging from complete EU registration packages, general consultancy work to sophisticated GLP field studies and various combinations of these elements. Furthermore, we offer environmental planning and environmental monitoring including eDNA services.

Interested in more information? Check what our colleagues say: This is RIFCON

For our Environmental Fate (Efate) team located in Hirschberg or Ludwigshafen / Germany we are looking for an experienced Environmental Fate / Modelling Scientist in full-time.

These tasks are waiting for you

You will be involved in various aspects of registration activities for active substances, plant protection products and biosolutions including:

- Environmental fate risk assessment for biological and chemical plant protection products (calculation of predicted environmental concentrations in soil, groundwater, surface water, air…) and reporting
- Preparation of dossiers for authorization of active substances and plant protection products according to European and national requirements
- Evaluation and monitoring of laboratory and field studies on substance behaviour (e.g. kinetic evaluation of degradation studies to derive half-lives)
- Analyses of studies and data packages for guideline compliance and data gaps
- Close cooperation with our clients, scientific units and regulatory authorities
- Project management and strategic consultancy, development of higher tier strategies for refinement after an extensive 'on-the-job' learning phase

You convince us with

- Scientific background (geoecology, environmental sciences, geography, geoscience or similar)
- Professional experience in environmental fate modelling in either consultancy, authority or industry preferred; motivated candidates with professional experience as study director for environmental fate studies might also be considered for the position
- Knowledge of environmental fate modelling (water and substance transport models, FOCUS models) and behaviour of chemicals in the environment (e.g. degradation kinetics, sorption isotherms)
- Experience with Regulation (EC) 1107/2009 would be advantageous
- Very good working knowledge of MS office tools; experience with programming languages (e.g. R or Python) would be an asset
- Very good level of written and spoken English, additional languages (especially German) are advantageous
- Self-motivation, problem-solving skills and diligent style of working
- Excellent communication and team player skills

What we offer

- An attractive working environment and multifaceted tasks
- Friendly and open working atmosphere
- To work as part of a dedicated international team of scientists and staff
- Possibility of professional development and occupational education
- An opportunity to expand your personal network in industry, science and regulatory bodies
- High degree of project and self-responsibility
- Home office and mobile work opportunities
- Flexible working hours
- Company health insurance (bKV)
- Meal allowance (Essenszuschuss)
- Support of Deutschland Ticket, employee parking spaces, company bike leasing (Jobbike)
- Employer childcare allowance
- Individual ergonomic advices, Yoga and sports
- Team events

Interested?

Then we look forward to receiving your application including your earliest possible starting date via our application form.

RIFCON GmbH
Goldbeckstraße 13
69493 Hirschberg
Deutschland

Phone: +49 (0) 6201 / 84528 00
Internet: www.rifcon.com

Are you looking to own the customer-facing experience for JetBrains products, from how individuals and organizations buy and manage software to how licensing and entitlements work behind the scenes?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll lead the strategy for BAD (Business Application Development) Product. You’ll tackle the complex web of purchases, subscriptions, organization administration, and usage-based services, making sure our customers have a smooth, coherent experience every step of the way.

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, QA, and BAD Platform, as well as Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams. You’ll have the autonomy to drive product discovery, validate hypotheses through data and experimentation, and define the long-term vision for our licensing and administration ecosystem.

Day to day, you will:

- Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for BAD Product systems.
- Uncover user friction through customer research, support data, telemetry, and feedback from internal teams.
- Map and improve end-to-end customer journeys covering purchasing, subscriptions, licensing, and administration.
- Identify gaps, overlaps, and inconsistencies across sub-systems to build a clear, unified user experience.
- Partner with engineering, design, analytics, and QA from early discovery through launch and continuous iteration.
- Define and track key product metrics for adoption, conversion, and support demand.
- Communicate product direction, trade-offs, and progress clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

- An ownership mindset, taking responsibility for outcomes, not just task completion.
- A clear focus on underlying problems and desired outcomes rather than immediate feature requests.
- Comfort with technical complexity, trade-offs, and systems thinking.
- A preference for quality, long-term sustainability, and user trust over short-term fixes.
- The ability to make grounded decisions using customer research, analytics, and experimentation.
- Strong collaboration skills across multi-disciplinary teams and distinct business areas.

What you’ll need

- A proven track record of managing technically complex SaaS, enterprise, or B2B product areas end to end.
- Hands-on experience driving product discovery, user research, and roadmap prioritization.
- Experience navigating complex customer journeys, multi-team dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Experience making data-informed decisions using telemetry, product metrics, and experimentation.
- The ability to work comfortably alongside engineering teams on technical details, APIs, data models, and system integrations.
- Fluency in English.

What success looks like

In practice, success means building a licensing and administration experience that feels seamless to the user and resilient under the hood. You'll bring clarity to ambiguous systems, simplify fragmented customer flows, and establish reliable product metrics. Ultimately, you succeed by removing friction for millions of developers and admins, allowing them to focus on their actual work.

Why join JetBrains?

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to read your application.

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships across assigned industrial markets and territory. Reporting to the Global Commercial Leader, you will execute strategic sales initiatives, identify opportunities for market expansion, and deliver value-driven solutions that help customers improve their manufacturing processes.

Your technical expertise, consultative selling approach, and ability to build lasting customer partnerships will be essential in achieving sales objectives and supporting the continued growth and profitability of the business.

A Day in the Life:

- Achieve assigned bookings, revenue and profitability targets.
- Develop and execute territory sales plans to identify and secure new business opportunities.
- Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through quotation, negotiation and closing.
- Identify AI-enabled solutions and digital services to support business growth and deliver measurable customer value.
- Maintain an accurate sales forecast and opportunity pipeline using Salesforce.com.
- Collaborate with partners and representatives to support commercial growth.
- Provide valuable market intelligence by monitoring market trends, competitive activities and customer-specific requirements.
- Develop trusted relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Analyze customer production processes and recommend technical solutions that improve quality, productivity and operational efficiency.
- Engage customers with AI-enabled discussions and commercial solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer experience through responsiveness, technical expertise and solution-oriented support.
- Demonstrate and present the technical capabilities and business value of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Quality Control Systems.
- Collaborate closely with application specialists, service engineers, software experts and product management to develop customer-specific solutions.
- Maintain a high level of product, application, industry and AI knowledge to effectively position our solutions.
- Travel throughout the assigned territory and internationally as required, with approximately 50% overnight travel.

What to expect:

- Drive sales growth by achieving commercial targets across the assigned territory.
- Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
- Lead complex technical sales engagements from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
- Deliver consultative, value-based sales solutions tailored to customer manufacturing processes.
- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.
- Utilize Salesforce.com to manage opportunities, forecasting and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends and competitive activities to support strategic business growth.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific through regular customer visits and extensive travel.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience.

Experience

- Minimum of 3 years of successful technical sales experience in capital equipment, industrial instrumentation, process analytics or industrial automation.
- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal
- Packaging & Converting
- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) together with digital sales and collaboration tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
- Additional language skills are an advantage.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively.
